title: Nixon ended the Apollo program and scrapped the Saturn fleet

tellings.quote: You know, one the more prosaic explanation is that Nixon decided to pull the plug on the Apollo program because the Vietnam War was costing us so much money

plain: Researcher Randall Carlson, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, discusses why the Apollo moon landings stopped between 1969 and 1972. He says the more ordinary explanation is that President Richard Nixon pulled the plug because the Vietnam War was costing so much money, which implies he weighs other, less ordinary reasons too.
